request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-18T11:45:00+02:00:
Gisteravond is er brand geweest in de woonkamer, de kachel. Alles is zwart en ingestort, de brandweer was er. Ik weet het rapportnummer nog niet. Kunnen jullie snel betalen want we kunnen er niet wonen.

[EV-0004] sent 2026-10-20T12:41:17.153414+00:00:
Het rapportnummer van de brandweer is BRW-2026-45102.

Repair estimate lines:
- FIRE-INTERIOR-REBUILD: Woonkamer strippen en herbouwen (age on estimate: not stated)
- DEMOLITION-DEBRIS: Sloop en afvoer (age on estimate: not stated)
- SOOT-CLEAN-ROOM: Roetreiniging overige ruimtes (3) (age on estimate: not stated)

what_happened.value: Fire in the living room, the stove; everything is black and collapsed
what_happened.quote: Gisteravond is er brand geweest in de woonkamer, de kachel. Alles is zwart en ingestort

fire_brigade_report_ref.quote: Het rapportnummer van de brandweer is BRW-2026-45102.

parsed_output.reasoning: Loss date resolved from 'gisteravond' relative to 2026-10-18 gives 2026-10-17. The fire brigade was present, and the report number was provided later in EV-0004. It is not stated whether the fire is out, so source_stopped is null. No item ages were given.
parsed_output.summary: Customer reports a stove fire in the living room on the evening of 2026-10-17, with severe damage making the home uninhabitable; the fire brigade attended, report number BRW-2026-45102.
